children: US investment bank's preliminary Q3 revenue rose 9% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS not disclosed; net earnings attributable to common shareholders increased yr/yr
Company repurchased 1.3 mln shares for $70 mln and raised buyback authorization to $250 mln
Jefferies says it is optimistic about the balance of 2026 and momentum heading into 2027
Company expects higher operating margins and earnings as it completes the sale of Tessellis
Joint venture with SMBC in Japan expected to begin serving clients in January 2027
INVESTMENT BANKING GAINS - Record investment banking net revenues driven by strong advisory and equity underwriting activity, attributed to market share gains and increased market opportunity
EQUITIES MOMENTUM - Equities net revenues reached a record, supported by higher global trading volumes in cash and electronic trading and expansion of prime services
FIXED INCOME WEAKNESS - Fixed Income net revenues declined 26% yr/yr due to ongoing lower industry volumes
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the investment banking & brokerage services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Jefferies Financial Group Inc is $65.00, about 36.3% above its September 25 closing price of $47.68
The stock recently traded at 11 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 13 three months ago
